description_en: Detects real faces by using pre-acquired face images passed through the API operation. The algorithm primarily identifies whether the face is a basic render liveness attack such as a screen recapture or a printed photo, and supports comparing the image with another face image to authenticate whether it is the same person
description_zh: 通过API接口传入提前获取的人脸图片进行真实人脸检测的服务，算法主要识别人脸是否为屏幕翻拍、打印图片此类基础呈现活体攻击的类型 ，并支持与另一张人脸图片比对验证是否为同一人

parameters.help_en:
Required when ProductCode is set to FACE_IDU_MIN. The authentication type. Valid values:
0: Retrieval pattern.
Feature: Passes the face library and the user face image (sourceFacePicture). The system automatically retrieves whether the specified face image (sourceFacePicture) already exists in the face library. Passive liveness detection can be enabled for the face image (sourceFacePicture).
Recommended scenario: Scenarios where real persons create an account and duplicate registrations are not allowed.

1: Authentication pattern. Default value.
Feature: Passes the specified face image (sourceFacePicture) and the reference face image (TargetFacePicture). The system automatically authenticates whether the faces match. Passive liveness detection can be enabled for the specified face image (sourceFacePicture).
Recommended scenario: Scenarios where it is necessary to authenticate whether the operation is performed by the user themselves when modifying logon or account information.

2: Comprehensive pattern.
Feature: Passes the face library, the specified face image (sourceFacePicture), and the reference face image (TargetFacePicture) at the same time. The system automatically retrieves whether the specified face image (sourceFacePicture) exists in the face library and authenticates whether it matches the reference face. Passive liveness detection can be enabled for the specified face image (sourceFacePicture).
Recommended scenario: Scenarios where it is necessary to authenticate that the user is a new user and the operation is performed by the user themselves
parameters.help_zh:
当ProductCode=FACE_IDU_MIN,需要入参
验证类型：
0：检索模式
功能：传入人脸库和用户人脸图片（sourceFacePicture）系统自动检索人脸库中是否已经存该指定人脸图片（sourceFacePicture），且人脸图片（sourceFacePicture）支持开启静默活体检测。
建议场景：真人注册账号且不允许重复注册场景。

1（默认）：验证模式
功能：传入指定人脸图片（sourceFacePicture）与留底人脸图片（TargetFacePicture），系统自动验证是否与人脸一致，且指定人脸图片（sourceFacePicture）支持开启静默活体检测。
建议场景：修改登录、账号等信息时需验证是否为本人操作的场景。

2：综合模式
功能：同时传入人脸库、指定人脸图片（sourceFacePicture）与留底人脸图片（TargetFacePicture），系统自动检索人脸库中是否存在指定人脸图片（sourceFacePicture），是否与留底人脸一致，且指定人脸图片（sourceFacePicture）支持开启静默活体检测。
建议场景：需要验证是新增用户且是本人操作场景

DuplicateFace.description_en: The corresponding face ID, user ID, and comparison score in the face library returned when a duplicate face is retrieved

FaceAttributeInfo.description_en: The attribute detection result of the main face, returned as a string. It includes information such as gender, glasses, hat, mask, tattoo, smoking, other people, environment, expression, and age
FaceAttributeInfo.description_zh: 主人脸的属性检测结果，以字符串形式返回，包括性别、眼镜、帽子、口罩、纹身、吸烟、其他人员、环境、表情和年龄等信息

FaceQualityScore.description_en: The quality score of the live face. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
FaceQualityScore.description_zh: 活体人脸质量分数。取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

IlluminationScore.description_en: The algorithm score for illumination, which is a sub-dimension of quality assessment. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
IlluminationScore.description_zh: 质量判断子维度，光照的算法分数，取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

KaOcclusionScore.description_en: The algorithm score for key area occlusion, which is a sub-dimension of quality assessment. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
KaOcclusionScore.description_zh: 质量判断子维度，关键区域遮挡的算法分数，取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

OcclusionScore.description_en: The algorithm score for occlusion, which is a sub-dimension of quality assessment. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
OcclusionScore.description_zh: 质量判断子维度，遮挡的算法分数，取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

SharpnessScore.description_en: The sharpness score of the image, which is a sub-dimension of quality assessment. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher value indicates better quality
SharpnessScore.description_zh: 质量判断子维度，图片清晰度分数，取值范围0～100，数值越大质量越好

TargetFaceQualityScore.description_en: The overall quality score of the reference face image. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher score indicates better quality
TargetFaceQualityScore.description_zh: 人脸留底图片综合质量分，取值范围为 0～100，分数越高表示质量越好

TargetIlluminationScore.description_en: The illumination score of the reference face image. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher score indicates better quality
TargetIlluminationScore.description_zh: 人脸留底图片光照评分，取值范围为 0～100，分数越高表示质量越好

TargetKaOcclusionScore.description_en: The key area occlusion score of the reference face image. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher score indicates better quality
TargetKaOcclusionScore.description_zh: 人脸留底图片关键区域遮挡评分，取值范围为 0～100，分数越高表示质量越好

TargetOcclusionScore.description_en: The occlusion score of the reference face image. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher score indicates better quality
TargetOcclusionScore.description_zh: 人脸留底图片遮挡评分，取值范围为 0～100，分数越高表示质量越好

TargetSharpnessScore.description_en: The sharpness score of the reference face image. Valid values: 0 to 100. A higher score indicates better quality
TargetSharpnessScore.description_zh: 人脸留底图片清晰度评分，取值范围为 0～100，分数越高表示质量越好
